# `spoof`

Scenario kind of the engine v0.38.0, family [Jamming, spoofing and the spectrum](../jamming-spoofing-and-the-spectrum.md). Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. Every label here is the engine's or the verification matrix's; a kind is MODELLED unless the matrix says otherwise (how a label is earned: the README's Evidence section).

## What it does

Stochastic time-spoof detector (Neyman–Pearson / χ²₁) with Monte-Carlo P_fa/P_md.

One run of `scenarios/spoof-attack.toml` summarises as: scenario 2b6bd22c3b80 | spoof LinearRamp { rate_ns_per_s: 0.1 } vs 20.000 ns spec (P_fa 0.010) | quantum security 1.000 (P_md 0.000, MC 0.000) detected 70s | classical security 0.558 (P_md 0.442, MC 0.444) detected 430s
